drhp.business: Wonderla Holidays Limited operates amusement parks across Kochi, Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Bhubaneswar, with a recent expansion into Chennai, each offering a balanced mix of thrill, water and family attractions supported by in-house capabilities in ride design and maintenance. The Company has evolved into an integrated entertainment platform extending beyond rides into hospitality, food and beverage, retail and event-led offerings, with the Bengaluru resort 'Isle by Wonderla' complementing the core park offering and contributing to non-ticket revenue. risks.note: Management describes the year as one of achieving footfall and revenue growth 'while navigating higher cost pressures arising from the commissioning of the ISLE and Chennai park' — new capacity carries launch and operating costs ahead of a mature revenue base.
risks.risk: Cost pressure from newly commissioned assets

risks.note: The Company recorded an exceptional item on account of the impact of the new labour code within total expenses for FY 2025-26, showing that statutory labour changes flow directly into the cost base of a people-intensive park operation.

Regulatory developments relevant to the amusement park and entertainment industry are treated as a standing Board-level topic, covered as a dedicated theme in the FY 2025-26 familiarisation programme for Independent Directors.

IT systems, cybersecurity practices and data governance were a specific familiarisation topic for the Board during FY 2025-26, reflecting exposure as booking, ticketing and guest-data systems move online.

sk.overview: The overnight ocean and coastal cruise industry in India is a nascent, high-growth segment of cruise tourism. Per the issuer-commissioned CRISIL Report (May 2026), the domestic market was valued at approximately Rs 8,301 million in Fiscal 2025 (up from Rs 5,764 million in Fiscal 2020, ~8% CAGR) but is estimated to have declined ~12% to Rs 7,325 million in Fiscal 2026 amid macro/fuel/geopolitical headwinds, before a projected sharp expansion. India's cruise penetration (~0.01%) is far below developed markets (~5.7% in North America), indicating large untapped potential. The global cruise …
